title: Go Tiki Tours Tampa "#1 Floating Tiki Boat" Bathroom on Board
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Join us on a 2-Hour Private Day Tour, the ultimate celebration destination on Downtown Tampa Riverwalk! Whether you're toasting to a birthday, waving goodbye to the single life with a bachelorette party, or enjoying a family outing, our tiki boat offers the perfect blend of fun and relaxation. Cruise along the river waters of Downtown Tampa on our tiki boat, creating memories against the backdrop of the city's skyline. Each tour transforms into a personalized river cruise experience, tailored to make your special occasions even more memorable. 

For groups of more than 6, the captain is hired separately. We will provide a list of our favorite USCG-Qualified captains for you to hire after your reservation is complete.

Join us on the river and discover why our tiki boat is the go-to thing to do in Tampa Bay. Book now and anchor down your perfect day in Downtown Tampa Riverwalk.
